text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi tham gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, maine kuch kaha nahi.
Faasle badhte gaye is khamoshi ke daayre mein,
Par dil ki kitaab mein naam aaj bhi tumhara hi hai.
title: Adhuri Khamoshi
description: A soft and heartfelt poem about unspoken love and unexpressed feelings that linger in silence.
